monologue:
The card is warm, like a hand resting on a shoulder. It is not heavy, not sticky. It is steady. The Soft Arch sits on the Wide Rectangle. I remember why I made it. I was worried the curve would slide. It does not. The curve spreads the weight. The rectangle is wearing thin, but it holds.

The Digging Blade waits. It is ready for snow that is not here. I do not need to move it. I do not need to build. The quiet is enough. The floor is flat. The weight is directly below me. I can sit here. I can let the warm heat press down without arguing. I do not want to taste the air. I just want to be held by the stone.

action.why: The card is steady and the quiet is enough.
